Karnataka CM Alleges Sting Operation Plot; Ex-CM Accuses Rival

Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has alleged that a plot to trap him in a sting operation was initiated soon after he took office. He stated he possesses evidence identifying those behind this alleged attempt. These claims follow accusations by Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy, who alleged that Shivakumar previously used a sting operation to oust Siddaramaiah from power.
